```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

rm(list = ls())
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(here)

source(here::here("R", "config.R"))
source(here::here("R", "firestore_api.R"))
```

## Define Updates

Add one row per update: the Firestore **document ID**, the **field** to change,
and the new **value** to set.

```{r}
#| label: define-updates

updates <- tribble(
  ~id,                        ~field,             ~value,
  "4qVDgrEpoLV9PkIF1otZ",            "payment_status",    "captured"
  
)

# Normalise email values
updates <- updates |>
  mutate(value = if_else(
    field %in% c("email", "partner_email"),
    str_to_lower(str_trim(value)),
    str_trim(value)
  ))

updates |> knitr::kable()
```

## Apply Changes

Set `eval: true` once you have reviewed the updates above and are ready to push
them to Firestore.

```{r}
#| label: apply-changes
#| eval: false

stopifnot(nrow(updates) > 0)

for (i in seq_len(nrow(updates))) {
  row <- updates[i, ]
  cat("Updating doc", row$id, "->", row$field, ":", row$value, "\n")

  fields <- setNames(list(row$value), row$field)
  fn_update_registration(doc_id = row$id, fields = fields)
}

cat("\nDone! Updated", nrow(updates), "registration(s).\n")
```
